title: Husband, wife 75: lost vision in one eye, left hand numb

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 3301 Irving Street. My wife is 75, something's wrong with her.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: All of a sudden she can't see out of her right eye, it just went dark, and her left hand is numb.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Can she squeeze your hand with her left hand?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She's trying, but it's weak, she can barely hold my fingers.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was she last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ten minutes ago. We were having breakfast and she was fine.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Does she take any blood thinners?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She takes a baby aspirin every day.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Stay on the line with me.
